bugs.error_message: TestSponzaDeferred GBuffer→Lighting output solid blue/orange/black — no geometry pixels visible in lighting

bugs.error_message: TestSponzaDeferred vertex varyings all zero/uniform in pixel shader — normals/texcoords don't vary across triangles

bugs.fix: Replaced hardcoded offsets with offsetof(FVertex, Position)/offsetof(FVertex, Normal)/offsetof(FVertex, UV)/offsetof(FVertex, Tangent).

bugs.error_message: writeBuffer: dataSize + destOffsetBytes is greater than the buffer size
bugs.root_cause: MaterialConstantBuffer created with 28 bytes (sizeof(float)*4 + sizeof(float)*3) but C++ wrote 32 bytes (float[8]) per draw call. NVRHI validation caught the overflow when shader cbuffer layout changed.
bugs.fix: Changed MatCBDesc.byteSize from sizeof(float)*7 to sizeof(float)*8 to match the actual MaterialConstants cbuffer layout in HLSL (float4 + 4 floats = 32 bytes).

bugs.error_message: VUID-vkCmdTraceRaysKHR-None-08608: VkPipeline does not set up VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_VIEWPORT|VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_SCISSOR but calls related dynamic state commands
bugs.root_cause: Known Vulkan validation layer false positive (#8038). Dynamic viewport/scissor from prior graphics pipeline incorrectly attributed to ray-tracing dispatch. Triggered because non-volatile constant buffer in writeBuffer() calls endRenderPass() before setRayTracingState(), creating command sequence that exposes the layer bug. Donut avoids it by using volatile buffers (no endRenderPass in writeBuffer).
bugs.fix: Added messageIdNumber-based filtering to DebugCallback (DeviceManagerVk5_Misc.cpp) and suppressed 0x29056f6a in TestRTShadowsGBuffer.cpp IgnoredVulkanValidationMessageLocations. Alternative (volatile buffers) would require BindingLayoutItem::VolatileConstantBuffer refactoring.

bugs.error_message: KTX texture loading: 'Two or more immediate command lists cannot be open at the same time' followed by 'command list must be opened'
bugs.root_cause: UploadCmdList was opened before a loop that creates and opens per-texture KtxCmdList handles. NVRHI only allows one immediate command list to be open at a time, so KtxCmdList->open() failed. Subsequent writeTexture calls hit 'command list must be opened' because handle was still in INITIAL state.
bugs.fix: Moved UploadCmdList->open() to after the KTX loading loops, so it only opens once per-texture command lists have been closed and executed by LoadKTX2Texture/LoadTexture.

bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: SuccessCount should be UniqueSuccessCount
Few-bounce GI output is sparse snow-flower noise with no coherent shading or direct lighting; per-frame flicker
bugs.root_cause: (1) RayGen fires 1 ray per pixel — no SPP loop. (2) ClosestHit declares 'in float3 hitAttr : SV_HitT' but SV_HitT is a scalar (ray T); HLSL broadcasts to (T,T,T) and normalize() yields constant (0.577,0.577,0.577) — every surface in bounces 1-3 has identical NdotL. (3) albedo is hardcoded float3(0.7) — no GBuffer sampling at hit. (4) throughput *= 0.5 per bounce darkens GI further. ReSTIR resamples a 1-SPP input, FrameIndex in candidate hash causes per-frame flicker, spatial pass adopts neighbor's y (random screen pixel) and discards W weight.
bugs.fix: P0: Fix FewBounceGI.hlsl — remove hitAttr as normal, use WorldRayOrigin()+WorldRayDirection()*RayTCurrent() for hitPosition, sample GBuffer at hit, add SPP loop in RayGen. P1: ReSTIR_Generate — drop FrameIndex from candidate positions, increase radius, apply W in spatial output, use real BRDF evaluation. P2: Remove unused TemporalRadiance/RadianceHistory textures.

bugs.error_message: Post SV_HitT fix: Sponza geometry is visible in frame dumps but covered in snow-flower noise that flickers per frame. No color variation, no shadows, no direct light highlights. User describes as 'snow flower flickering, no real GI or direct rendering'.
bugs.root_cause: Predecessor critic (bug-045) was correct that the structural issues exist, but its visual description (90% black, sparse speckle) is no longer accurate after the SV_HitT→barycentric normal fix landed in the working tree. Current dumps show Sponza geometry clearly visible. Remaining issues: (1) RayGen still 1-SPP, (2) albedo still hardcoded float3(0.7) in FewBounceGI.hlsl:258 (TODO), (3) no shadow ray / no sky-occlusion ambient, (4) ReSTIR_Generate_cs.hlsl:76 puts FrameIndex INSIDE the candidate-position hash so y flickers per frame on a static scene, (5) ReSTIR_Spatial_cs.hlsl:130 computes W then discards it (raw gRadiance[y] output), (6) ReSTIR_Temporal binds CurrentRadiance/HistoryRadiance/OutRadiance but the temporal shader doesn't read or write them — temporal pass is reservoir-only and does not stabilize per-frame output.
bugs.fix: P0 (recognizable Sponza): (A) Sample GBufferDiffuse at hit position for albedo in FewBounceGI.hlsl:258. (B) Add SPP loop in RayGen — for s=0..SPP accumulate payload.radiance. (C) Sky-occlusion ambient in ClosestHit — SampleSky(hitNormal)*0.3. P1 (kill flicker): (D) Remove gConstants.FrameIndex from candidate-position hash in ReSTIR_Generate_cs.hlsl:76 — use hash22(pixel + float2(i*7, i*13)) and keep FrameIndex only on the selection step (line 91). (E) Apply W in spatial output: gOutput = float4(outRadiance * W, 1.0) with W clamped to [0,5]. P2: tighten normal/depth thresholds in spatial pass, increase generation radius after SPP fix, wire up or remove TemporalRadianceTexture/RadianceHistoryTexture.

bugs.error_message: ReSTIR snow-flower flicker + uniform-gray bounce + ViewConstants reading garbage. Post-fix from bug-046.
bugs.root_cause: Three independent bugs fixed in commit 2d36716: (1) ReSTIR_Spatial used naive 'pick one y from neighbor, output radiance[y]' — for 1-SPP input this propagates a single bright speckle to 9 spatial neighbors with no calibration, causing the snow-flower flicker. (2) FewBounceGI.hlsl ClosestHit used per-instance info.AlbedoColor which was unset/zero for the few-bounce path, making all bounce-hit materials look uniform gray regardless of Sponza's actual red/marble/brick textures. (3) TestFewBounceGI.cpp binding layout declared ViewConstants at slot 512 — should be 257 (b0=256, b1=256+1) given bRegShift=256 — so the GI shader was reading the wrong constant buffer for camera/clip-space info, producing nonsense clipPos in the new GBuffer reprojection path.
bugs.fix: (1) Replaced spatial merge with pairwise MIS weighted blend: numerator = sum_i(w_sum_i * radiance_i), denominator = sum_i(M_i * p_hat_i), output = numerator/denominator. Added MaxM clamp and per-reservoir radiance lookup. (2) In FewBounceGI.hlsl ClosestHit, replaced `float3 albedo = info.AlbedoColor` with screen-space reprojection of the primary pass's GBufferDiffuse texture: project hit position through ViewMatrix*ProjMatrix, sample GBufferDiffuse.Load at the resulting pixel. (3) Changed BindingLayoutItem::ConstantBuffer(512) -> ConstantBuffer(257) and matching BindingSetItem::ConstantBuffer(512, ...) -> ConstantBuffer(257, ...) in TestFewBounceGI.cpp.

bugs.root_cause: copyTexture() from DenoisedHDRTexture (RGBA32F) to ReBLURHistoryTexture (RGBA16F) is ILLEGAL in Vulkan — formats are not size-compatible (16 bytes vs 8 bytes per texel). bugs.fix: Changed ReBLUR history texture format from RGBA16_FLOAT to RGBA32_FLOAT to match the output texture. Also fixed temporal blend factor from confidence=(FrameIndex-1)/HistoryFadeIn (converges to 100% current) to alpha=max(1/(FrameIndex+1), 1/HistoryFadeIn) for proper exponential moving average.

bugs.error_message: ReBLUR temporal accumulation had no signal to accumulate — ReBLUR-only output frames were byte-identical across 4 frames
bugs.root_cause: Per-pixel GI seed depended only on pixel coordinates (pixel.x * 1920u + pixel.y). R0 fixed per-sample/per-bounce independence but did not include frame index, so every frame produced identical ray paths. ReBLUR saw identical input every frame.
bugs.fix: Inject TemporalFrameCount into ViewConstants padding slot [50] and add it to pixelSeed with a large prime multiplier: pixelSeed = pixel.x * 1920u + pixel.y + (uint)g_View.FrameIndex * 73856093u.

bugs.error_message: ReBLUR spatial blur overwrote temporal result and collapsed to black when bilateral weights were zero
bugs.root_cause: SpatialBlur returned float3(0.0) when weightSum < 0.001, and main() assigned the blurred value directly to temporal.radiance, discarding the accumulated history.
bugs.fix: Changed SpatialBlur fallback to return temporalRadiance. Changed main() to lerp(temporal.radiance, blurred, SpatialAlpha) so spatial blur is additive rather than a destructive overwrite.

bugs.error_message: ReBLUR view-position reconstruction was wrong for LH_ZO projection, causing spatial blur weights to reject valid neighbors

bugs.fix: Use depth directly in clipPos: float4(uv * 2.0 - 1.0, depth, 1.0).
